message.jaymospowers.mortality.ended: That life is over. Another begins.
message.jaymospowers.mortality.wake.boss: You wake to birdsong. Whatever it was, it let you go.
message.jaymospowers.mortality.wake.zomb: You wake far from the stench. The bite throbs.
message.jaymospowers.mortality.wake.skel: You wake with an arrow still in you. The leg won't hold.
message.jaymospowers.mortality.wake.blas: Your ears ring. Your legs won't answer.
message.jaymospowers.mortality.wake.veno: You wake in a cold sweat. The bite has gone dark.
message.jaymospowers.mortality.wake.pois: You wake retching. Something is still in your blood.
message.jaymospowers.mortality.wake.with: You wake grey and cold to the bone.
message.jaymospowers.mortality.wake.fire: You wake with your skin tight and raw.
message.jaymospowers.mortality.wake.drow: You wake on the shore, coughing up water.
message.jaymospowers.mortality.wake.fall: You wake where you landed. Your legs are wrong.
message.jaymospowers.mortality.wake.envi: You wake, barely. Something in you didn't come back.
message.jaymospowers.mortality.wake.play: You wake alone. They left you for dead.
message.jaymospowers.mortality.wake.othe: You wake somewhere else. You don't remember how.
message.jaymospowers.affliction.venom.st: The bite is hot and swelling. It needs drawing out, honey or an antidote.
message.jaymospowers.affliction.venom.1: The venom spreads. Your arms feel heavy.
message.jaymospowers.affliction.venom.2: The world swims. The venom is in your legs now.
message.jaymospowers.affliction.venom.3: You can barely stand. There isn't long.
message.jaymospowers.affliction.venom.cu: The swelling goes down. The venom is out.
message.jaymospowers.affliction.poisoned: Your blood feels thick and wrong. Honey, a healer or a mage might draw it out.
Your limbs are weak. The poison is winning.
Your heart stumbles. The poison has nearly run its course.
message.jaymospowers.affliction.wet_lung: Water sits in your lungs. Only a doctor or a court mage can draw it out.
You cough until you see stars.
It goes down the wrong way. You choke.
You cough up the last of the water. You can breathe.
message.jaymospowers.affliction.witherin: Something grey has taken hold of you. Milk, honey or a wizard might stop it.
The grey lifts. Your strength will come back slowly.
message.jaymospowers.scar.burns: The burns will scar. Your skin will never be as tough.
message.jaymospowers.scar.weak_lungs: Your lungs will never be the same. You tire sooner.
message.jaymospowers.scar.frostbite: Your fingers stay stiff and numb.
message.jaymospowers.scar.lightning: Branching scars cover your body. Your heart beats unevenly.
message.jaymospowers.scar.wasting: Hunger has taken something from you that won't come back.
message.jaymospowers.scar.crushed: Your ribs knit crooked. Every step pulls.
message.jaymospowers.mortality.arrow_out: With the leg held still, you work the arrowhead free.
message.jaymospowers.mortality.mended: You've mended. You're no longer living on borrowed time.
message.jaymospowers.mortality.wake.shel: You wake to low voices and the smell of herbs. Someone found you and carried you in.
message.jaymospowers.mortality.wake.capt: You wake in chains. Your things are gone.
message.jaymospowers.mortality.wake.rise: You wake cold. Nothing hurts. Your heart isn't beating.
